title: Zebra Technologies Completes Debt Refinancing
summary: Zebra Technologies, a global leader in digitizing and automating workflows to deliver intelligent operations, today announced actions to refinance its debt and expand liquidity.
body_markdown:
**Lincolnshire, Ill., Nov. 24, 2026** ─[Zebra Technologies Corporation](https://www.zebra.com/us/en.html) (NASDAQ: ZBRA), a global leader in digitizing and automating workflows to deliver intelligent operations, today announced actions to refinance its debt and expand liquidity.


*Debt Refinancing Highlights:*


- The refinanced facility is a five-year $3.50 billion senior secured credit facility consisting of a $1.75 billion revolving credit facility and $1.75 billion of term loans.
- This facility improves pricing by reducing certain commitment fees for unused revolving commitments by up to 2.5 basis points and the interest rate for Term SOFR Rate loans by 10 basis points.


On Nov. 20, 2026, the Company closed on a $3.50 billion senior secured credit facility maturing Nov. 2031 with a pricing at Term SOFR + 1.00% when net debt leverage ratio is at or below 1.5x. The refinanced credit facility removed the credit spread adjustment which improves pricing by 10 basis points for, with respect to dollars, Term SOFR Rate loans. The refinanced credit facility also implemented 2.5 basis point favorable pricing with respect to commitment fees on revolving commitments when the Company’s net debt leverage ratio is below 2.5x. The refinanced credit facility has $250 million in increased capacity, consisting of a $1.75 billion revolving credit facility and $1.75 billion in term loans. The Company’s facility prior to refinancing was a $3.25 billion senior secured credit facility maturing May 2027 consisting of a $1.50 billion revolving credit facility and $1.75 billion of term loans.


“With this transaction, Zebra has increased its available borrowing capacity to provide optimal flexibility for investment in our business,” said Nathan Winters, Chief Financial Officer of Zebra Technologies. “Our team was able to secure favorable terms, while reducing Zebra’s borrowing costs.”


JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. was the lead left arranger on the structuring and syndication of the refinanced credit facility, and Zebra Technologies engaged Sidley Austin LLP as counsel for the transaction.
